name: morpho-builder
description: Build and review Morpho Vault V2 Earn, Blue variable-rate borrow, and Midnight fixed-rate, fixed-maturity borrow integrations with REST reads, Actions API transactions, Merkl rewards, and product-specific UX, safety, and review guidance

interface.longDescription: Guidance for developers building and reviewing Morpho Vault V2 Earn with Vault V1 compatibility, Blue variable-rate borrowing and Midnight fixed-rate, fixed-maturity borrowing. Uses REST reads, Actions API transactions and Merkl rewards, with UX, safety and review checkers. Actions API keys stay server-side. This plugin contains skills only; it does not connect to an MCP server or execute transactions.
capabilities: Morpho Vault V2: build/review earn integrations where users deposit loan assets (e.g. stablecoins) to earn yield
Morpho Blue: build/review variable-rate market integrations for stablecoin loans against crypto collateral
Morpho Midnight: build/review fixed-rate, fixed-maturity borrowing integrations on supported chains
